description: Returns the members of Congress with the most trades in CTA's records, by trade count, optionally filtered by chamber (House or Senate) and date window.

days.description: Look-back window in days, measured on trade date (default 90). Disclosures can arrive up to 45 days after the trade (later if filed late), so the newest part of any window is incomplete.

name: get_top_traders
title: Top Traders
